name: refsure
description: Checks the references on public arXiv and OpenReview papers against public databases. The developer receives nothing.
author: shashank11yadav

scripts.build: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b edge && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b edge && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.verify: tsc --noEmit && eslint . && vitest run && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate
